body.statement:
Let \(q\) be a kernel induced by a hidden-variable recursive structural causal model and let \(\pi_1\) and \(\pi_2\) be valid fixing sequences for the same set of random vertices in the same CADMG. Then
\[
 \phi_{\pi_1}(q;G)=\phi_{\pi_2}(q;G).
\]

source.locator: Section 3, paragraph immediately following the recursive definition of kernel fixing
source.verbatim_statement: For valid sequences on the same set, \(\phi_{\pi_1}(q_{\vec V};\mathcal G)=\phi_{\pi_2}(q_{\vec V};\mathcal G)\).

attestation.note: The displayed equality was transcribed from Section 3 of arXiv:2404.06602v2.
